rows.name: Hall Effect/Rapid Trigger
rows.note: Still the competitive-play default with no league bans in force; buzz plateauing as attention shifts toward TMR switches.

rows.name: Cherry MX2A
rows.note: No fresh QC complaints this week; reviewers now frame MX2A as the premium traditionalist pick against Gateron's value tier.

rows.name: Gateron Magnetic Jade Emerald
rows.note: The first tactile Hall Effect switch on the market is drawing strongly positive reviews for its bump feel and adjustable actuation.

rows.name: Durock T1
rows.note: No new developments this week; T1 holds steady as a budget-tactile staple with no fresh vendor or group-buy activity.

rows.name: Gateron Oil King
rows.note: Backordered at some vendors but in stock at others; the scarcity is keeping Oil King in active hunt conversations.

rows.name: GMK CYL Orange Alert
rows.note: The group buy's final day lands today, Sept 14, via Divinikey and KBDfans — peak-week buzz before it closes.

rows.name: DCS Dolch / Molch
rows.note: Both Dolch and sibling Molch have moved past group-buy buzz into quiet post-buy production tracking.

rows.name: GMK CYL OG Extensions
rows.note: Evergreen extension kit remains in stock across vendors with no new interest-check activity this cycle.

rows.name: Split/Ergo layout
rows.note: Market growth data plus fresh product pushes keep split/ergo the strongest structural trend in the tracker.

rows.name: Alice layout
rows.note: Enthusiast guides now frame Alice as a gateway ergo layout rather than a decline; sentiment keeps recovering.

rows.name: 75% Layout
rows.note: Cited as the fastest-growing form factor of the last three years, now a plurality favorite for hybrid work-and-gaming setups.

rows.name: Mode Designs
rows.note: The 2026 Sonnet and Encore refresh is moving from preorder into in-stock sales, sustaining strong momentum.

rows.name: CannonKeys
rows.note: Blaine V2: SE closed Aug 9, but steady vendor chatter keeps the board in conversation.

rows.name: Prototypist
rows.note: Carbon-neutral shipping messaging and steady UK distribution keep Prototypist a stable operator with no volatility this week.

rows.name: Keychron
rows.note: Continued CES-era press and a well-funded crowdfunding campaign keep Keychron's ubiquity intact.

rows.name: Cherry (MX + XTRFY)
rows.note: A new TMR switch launch is landing as a genuine redemption arc after the MX2A-era slump, with sentiment turning upward.

rows.name: Topre / HHKB
rows.note: Vendor commentary points to electrocapacitive growth outpacing MX this year, with a Pro Hybrid promo sustaining interest.

rows.name: TMR (Tunnel Magnetoresistance) switches
rows.note: A new magnetic sensing tech is emerging across several brands, pitched as Hall Effect's successor with finer resolution and lower power draw.
